title: Archbishop Rowan Williams gets it right on … life
excerpt: An amazing article and speech on the ecological crisis and more here … In this address, Archbishop Rowan Williams exemplifies the kind of theological mind and heart that I believe are central to “ a new kind of Christianity .”
